objects.name: a folded stack of evening papers

people.name: Patrick Sweeney
people.role: a shipping clerk who had come into money

secret.description: Clementine Bledsoe drinks alone in the Bar from 9:30 PM to 10:00 PM and will claim to have been anywhere else.
Rachel Kessler goes through the papers in the Victim's Suite from 8:00 PM while the victim is downstairs.
Abraham Margolis slips out to the Street from 10:00 PM to 10:30 PM to settle with a bookmaker.

motive.description: wanted the victim out of a lease

secret.description: Adelaide Havemeyer is alone with Patrick Sweeney in the Roof Garden from 10:00 PM, and kills Patrick Sweeney at 10:00 PM.

motive.description: was about to be exposed by the victim

secret.description: Alonzo Colquitt is not the person the register says. Nothing is hidden about the evening; the lie is in the paperwork.

people.name: Lorraine Renfro
people.role: a wine steward out of work since the Act

secret.description: Lorraine Renfro meets the victim alone in the Victim's Suite from 9:00 PM and asks for money.

method.name: a push from the roof garden
method.bodyEvidence: Fractures consistent with a fall of six storeys. Two fingernails torn back.

Patrick Sweeney was found in the Roof Garden. The coroner puts death between 9:30 PM and 10:00 PM. Fractures consistent with a fall of six storeys. Two fingernails torn back.
The roof door key is missing from the Front Desk. The roof door was found unlocked and the key is not on its hook.
Rain began at 7:00 PM and did not let up. Anyone out on the street after that came back in wet.
Abraham Margolis says Rachel Kessler came in off the street at 11:30 PM with a soaked coat, so Rachel Kessler was outside at 11:00 PM.
Alonzo Colquitt's papers do not hold up. Two signatures in the guest register, a month apart, are in different hands.
Found in the Victim's Suite: A lease assignment made out in Abraham Margolis's name, waiting only on Patrick Sweeney's signature.
Alonzo Colquitt says Patrick Sweeney told Abraham Margolis the lease would go to somebody else at the quarter day.
Found in the Front Desk: A typed page of dates and sums in Patrick Sweeney's file, headed with Adelaide Havemeyer's name.
Cornelius Corrigan says Patrick Sweeney told Adelaide Havemeyer that the story would run whether Adelaide Havemeyer liked it or not.
Found in the Front Desk: Three letters in Patrick Sweeney's hand to a woman Alonzo Colquitt is engaged to, kept in the drawer, the last one opened.
Cornelius Corrigan says Alonzo Colquitt told Patrick Sweeney to keep away, loud enough to turn heads.
Found in the Victim's Suite: A promissory note for $4,000 signed by Lorraine Renfro, endorsed to Patrick Sweeney, three months past due.
Abraham Margolis says Patrick Sweeney told Lorraine Renfro that Friday was the end of it, one way or the other.
